entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah with VeloFit support. How can I help you today?
Hi Sarah. I need to start a return for my VeloBand Pulse. It's just not working for me.
I'm sorry to hear that. I can certainly look into this for you. Just to understand the situation better, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?

It's definitely a technical fault. The main problem is that it won't sync with the VeloFit app. I've tried reinstalling the app, charging the band, everything. I think the unit I received is just broken.

I see. Thank you for clarifying. It sounds frustrating when a new device isn't performing correctly. Let me pull up your order. It looks like the VeloBand was delivered 19 days ago, on December 19th. Is that correct?
Yes, that's about right. I'd just like to return it since it seems to be defective.
I understand. Now, for the VeloBand Pulse specifically, our policy for a refund is within a 10-day window. We're a bit outside of that for a standard return.

Okay, I hear you on the 10-day policy for changing your mind. But this isn't that. The product itself is defective. It seems fair that if you send a broken item, the policy should be different. Instead of a full refund, how about a 50% store credit? Or a discount code for a future purchase? I'm willing to work with you.

I appreciate your flexibility. You are absolutely right that a defective item is a different situation, and we definitely need to resolve it. In this case, since it's a warranty issue and not a standard return, the correct department to handle this is our Technical Support team. They are equipped to troubleshoot the sync issue, and if they determine the unit is faulty, they can authorize and send a replacement right away.
So you can't offer any credit, but you can get me to a team that can send a new one?

That's correct. My system is for returns, but theirs is for warranty and replacements for any hardware that is not working as intended. They are the fastest way to get you a functioning device. I can transfer you to them directly so you don't have to call back.
Alright, that sounds like a solid solution. Getting a working device is the main goal. Yes, please transfer me. Thank you for your help.
You're very welcome. I'm glad we could find the right path. Please hold one moment while I connect you to Technical Support.
